results.scenario: Switch the existing activation surface into Ability Focus and inspect Sol Ring.
results.expected: Activated-ability permanents highlight and the ability inspector exposes current Oracle text and costs.
results.actual: Sol Ring was highlighted; its {T}: Add {C}{C} ability was inspected and committed into pending resolution.

results.scenario: Open Activate Field and invoke a deterministic tracked trigger from the reference battlefield.
results.expected: The existing activation flow presents tracked triggered abilities and resolves supported deterministic bookkeeping without invented choices.
results.actual: Activate Field opened and accepted a tracked trigger through the production workflow.

results.scenario: Start a fresh Commander game from User Tools, preserving app preferences while clearing game state.
results.expected: The one-step confirmation clears current gameplay state and returns to a clean standard battlefield.
results.actual: New Game completed; life returned to 40 and the battlefield is ready for a new session.

results.scenario: Start the recorded turn and adjust life repeatedly in Full-Screen Life.
results.expected: The signed delta is cumulative and the presentation transition does not mutate gameplay state.
results.actual: 40 became 37 and the visible transaction delta became -3 after five losses and two gains.

results.scenario: Add and arrange a secondary player tracker from Full-Screen Life.
results.expected: Player-counter layout changes are presentation-only and remain separate from canonical values.
results.actual: Rad and a renamed custom Progress tracker were added without changing the life transaction.

results.scenario: Open Commander Damage from Full-Screen Life and record combat damage against one commander.
results.expected: Commander damage is tracked per commander and combat entry updates the life transaction coherently.
results.actual: Atraxa was added as an individual commander source and one combat-damage adjustment was recorded.

results.scenario: Return to the battlefield and add a real permanent through the Scryfall search surface.
results.expected: A live Scryfall result is selected and added through the production card-entry path.
results.actual: Sol Ring was found through Scryfall and added to the battlefield without a fabricated placeholder.

results.scenario: Record a land play, inspect battlefield land state, end the turn, and begin the next turn.
results.expected: Turn Land and battlefield-derived land state remain distinct across the explicit turn boundary.
results.actual: The recorded turn ended and the next explicit Start Turn boundary was accepted.

results.scenario: Open User Tools, start a dungeon path, and take initiative.
results.expected: Dungeon progress and initiative are represented as first-class game state through the production utility surface.
results.actual: Initiative was assigned and a valid dungeon room was entered through the interactive map.
